expected.title: Two-sided power-filtration coinvariant growth in canonical dimension for nonzero modules over uniform pro-p Iwasawa algebras
expected.author: Matthew Emerton; Vytautas Paškūnas
expected.difficulty_reason: The noncommutative Iwasawa canonical dimension is identified with the commutative associated-graded Krull dimension. A Frobenius-ideal filtration sandwiches genuine group coinvariants between Hilbert-Samuel and Hilbert-Kunz lengths, giving a sharp exponential exponent for the specified uniform power tower.

material.preserved_editorial_scope:
\paragraph{Editorial problem boundary.}
Prove only the two-sided growth inequality of Proposition 2.18 below for a nonzero finitely generated \(k[[K]]\)-module, where \(k\) is a finite field of characteristic \(p\), \(K\) is a uniformly powerful pro-\(p\) group of positive \(p\)-adic dimension, and \(K_n=K^{p^n}\). The canonical delta dimension, exact filtration, graded coinvariant maps, and complete Hilbert--Samuel/Hilbert--Kunz sandwich proof are retained, including the authors\' alternative Hilbert--Samuel upper bound. No arbitrary filtration or arithmetic-density theorem is selected; remaining article statements are context only.
